title: CrossViT does not handle other than three channel images
author: Yash-10

comments.author: lucidrains
comments.body:
@Yash-10 hey Yash, thanks for your interest in the library

try adding `channels = 1` on the latest version when instantiating `CrossViT`?

comments.author: Yash-10
comments.body: Hi @lucidrains, yes, it works now with any number of channels. Thanks for the fix and this great library! We can close this if you wish.
